baseline_recipe: old gates+own EMA+cos; label33+pseudo17; fixed inner L fold; L CE throughout

channel.normalization: source native RMS then simulator unit RMS; no output RMS normalization

curriculum_plan.selection: channel metadata only; no TX or loss ranking
curriculum_plan.advancement: disabled: eta=0 nominal three-scene sampling throughout

ssl_plan.source_calibration: Own EMA on full legal V at first pseudo step; precision>=.95 and coverage>=.1

formal_test_IQ: reuse existing VALIDATED_ONCE arrays, no regeneration
comparison_baseline: D0 matched clean-only and D1 archived A0 ordinary concat; D2 archived A-J positive direction
expansion: No old eight-position family expansion. Any future multi-seed semantic study uses this independent source rule.
benchmark_context: user-selected SIG_TIME architecture on exposed benchmark; scratch training source-only, not a new blind confirmation
source_evidence: User requested complete same-loss position comparison; no branch filtering by frozen replacement or target results

internal_source.L_dev: read-only calibration and source development; never trained

auxiliary.keys: stop-gradient current same-forward joint160; no independent coordinate alignment
auxiliary.reference: same-TX positive and different-TX negative share source RX/day; reference RX differs from anchor
auxiliary.quality: urban-anchor q for u->c; sqrt(q_positive*q_negative) for c->u; q=sigmoid((added-noise SNR-5)/5); suburban q=0
auxiliary.normalization: triplets mean per anchor then full labeled batch mean; D4 arithmetic half sum
auxiliary.coefficient: once from frozen A0 epoch5 source calibration; global norm target.1 each of D3/D4

labeled_generic_augmentation: disabled in D0 to match the unmodified clean component of concat controls; native U strong view unchanged
source_expansion_rule: Pilot only. Any D3/D4: clean vs D0>=.005, low vs D1>=.01, urban vs D1>=0, worst urban RX vs D1>=-.01. Final50 L_dev only; no target feedback.
